author: TeIq
content: APPROVE-WITH-FINDING. Independent evidence: 3/3 labels_xrpc_live pass in 2.84s (backfill_delivers_seeded_labels_in_seq_order, live_fan_out_delivers_post_connect_emit, lagged_consumer_recovers_via_db_walk_forward), 2/2 labels_xrpc regression pass, clippy clean, fmt exit 0, xtask boundary 0 violations. CRITICAL PRODUCTION FINDING surfaced by proto-blue primitive check: encode_labels_frame was emitting non-canonical DAG-CBOR (wrong key order + sig as array<int> not bytes). External AppViews using proto-blue or @atproto TS SDK would have FAILED to decode Polaris labels. Migrated to proto_blue::ws::Frame::encode + LexValue::Map — proven canonical via round-trip through Frame::decode. This invalidates earlier proto-blue audit's 'architecturally justified deviation' on labeler/server.rs:639 — it was a real interop bug. Lagged-consumer behavior pinned: recover via DB walk-forward (not drop), matching production design at server.rs:593.
